asset_heavy.reason: Runs manufacturing plants and distribution centers in US, Mexico, Europe, China; precision bearing production needs ongoing capital equipment investment.

big_ticket.reason: Bearings are components bought in frequent repeat orders, typically small per-unit relative to buyer spending.

cyclical_demand.reason: Industrial and aerospace OEM bearings demand falls with industrial production and build rates; customers can cut orders in downturns.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are aerospace and defense primes, large industrial OEMs, and distributors serving them.

notes: Aerospace/defense and industrial segments both matter; recurring revenue judged from repeat OEM and distributor orders.

offers_products.reason: Manufactures precision roller bearings, plain bearings and engineered components for aerospace, defense and industrial uses.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from manufactured bearings; design support and service are incidental to product sales.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured bearings and engineered products, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Bearings are repeat-ordered components and replacement parts by OEMs and distributors, with sustained aerospace programs.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells bearings to industrial, aerospace and defense customers and distributors, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are aerospace and defense contractors, industrial manufacturers and distributors.
